title: 🔥 THE DETAILED HISTORY OF THE BIBLE – DID PROTESTANTS REMOVE BOOKS FROM IT? 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 THE DETAILED HISTORY OF THE BIBLE – DID PROTESTANTS REMOVE BOOKS FROM IT? 🔥
📖 Matthew 24:35 – "Heaven and earth will pass away, but My words will never pass away."

❓ QUESTION FROM A READER:
"Brother John, I heard some people say that the Bible is a ‘Catholic book’ and that Protestants removed books from it. Others say the Bible was changed throughout history. How do we know the Bible we have today is truly God’s Word?"

🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! The history of the Bible is often misunderstood, and many people spread false information about it. Did Protestants remove books from the Bible? Is the Bible we have today complete, accurate, and unchanged? Let’s go back to history and see the truth!

🔥 1. WHERE DID THE BIBLE COME FROM?
📖 2 Timothy 3:16 – "All Scripture is God-breathed and is useful for teaching, rebuking, correcting, and training in righteousness."
🔥 The Bible did NOT come from any specific church denomination—it came from GOD!

✔️ The Old Testament was written in Hebrew and Aramaic between 1400 BC – 400 BC.
✔️ The New Testament was written in Greek between AD 50 – 100.
✔️ The entire Bible (66 books) was recognized by the early Christians as the inspired Word of God.

💡 FACT: The Bible was completed long before the Roman Catholic Church was even established.
👉 It is NOT a "Catholic book"—it is GOD’S BOOK!
🚨 THE BIBLE IS THE WORD OF GOD, NOT THE WORD OF MAN!

🔥 2. DID PROTESTANTS REMOVE BOOKS FROM THE BIBLE?
📖 Deuteronomy 4:2 – "Do not add to what I command you and do not subtract from it, but keep the commands of the Lord your God that I give you."
🔥 No! The Protestant Bible (66 books) contains the exact books that were always considered Scripture by the Jews and early Christians.

✔️ The Hebrew Bible (Old Testament) always had 39 books.
✔️ Jesus and the Apostles quoted from these 39 books—but never from the extra books found in the Catholic Bible.
✔️ The additional books (called the Apocrypha) were never accepted as Scripture by the Jews, Jesus, or the early church.

💡 FACT: The Catholic Church officially ADDED the Apocrypha to their Bible in 1546—1,500 years after the time of Christ!
👉 It was not Protestants who removed books—it was the Catholic Church that added books!
🚨 THE TRUE BIBLE IS THE 66-BOOK CANON—NOTHING ADDED, NOTHING REMOVED!

🔥 3. WHY DOES THE CATHOLIC BIBLE HAVE MORE BOOKS?
📖 Proverbs 30:6 – "Do not add to His words, or He will rebuke you and prove you a liar."
🔥 The Catholic Bible contains 73 books instead of 66 because of the Apocrypha, which includes books like Tobit, Maccabees, and Wisdom.

✔️ The Jews NEVER accepted the Apocrypha as Scripture.
✔️ Jesus and the Apostles NEVER quoted from these books.
✔️ The early church REJECTED these books as inspired.

💡 FACT: The Catholic Church added these books to support unbiblical teachings (such as praying for the dead in 2 Maccabees 12:45).
👉 The Apocrypha contains historical value but is NOT the inspired Word of God.
🚨 THE TRUE WORD OF GOD STANDS UNCHANGED—ONLY 66 BOOKS ARE SCRIPTURE!

🔥 4. HAS THE BIBLE BEEN CHANGED THROUGH HISTORY?
📖 Isaiah 40:8 – "The grass withers and the flowers fall, but the word of our God endures forever."
🔥 No! The Bible has been preserved with amazing accuracy over thousands of years!

✔️ The Dead Sea Scrolls (discovered in 1947) confirmed that the Old Testament we have today is the same as it was over 2,000 years ago.
✔️ Over 5,800 ancient Greek manuscripts of the New Testament exist, proving its reliability.
✔️ Despite translations into different languages, the message of Scripture remains unchanged.

💡 FACT: No other ancient book in history has been preserved with such accuracy!
👉 God has protected His Word from corruption!
🚨 THE BIBLE HAS NEVER BEEN LOST, CHANGED, OR ALTERED—IT REMAINS PURE!

🔥 5. WHY DOES THIS MATTER?
📖 Psalm 119:160 – "The sum of Your word is truth, and every one of Your righteous rules endures forever."
🔥 If we do not have the true Bible, we cannot have the true gospel!

✔️ If books were removed, we would be missing parts of God’s Word.
✔️ If books were added, we would have human traditions mixed with Scripture.
✔️ If the Bible was changed, we could not trust God’s promises.

💡 FACT: The Protestant Bible (66 books) is the complete, unchanged, and true Word of God!
👉 No book is missing, no truth is lost—God has preserved His Word!
🚨 THE BIBLE IS THE FINAL AUTHORITY—NOT CHURCH TRADITION!

🔥 FINAL WARNING: MANY FALSE TEACHINGS COME FROM ADDING OR REMOVING SCRIPTURE!
📖 Revelation 22:18-19 – "If anyone adds to them, God will add to him the plagues described in this book, and if anyone takes away from the words of this book, God will take away his share in the tree of life."

🚨 The Catholic Church added books to justify false teachings!
🚨 Many cults (like Mormons & Jehovah’s Witnesses) have changed the Bible to fit their doctrines!
🚨 Satan’s goal is to twist Scripture so people believe lies instead of truth!

🔥 WHAT WILL YOU DO?
❌ Believe false claims that the Bible was changed?
✔️ Trust in the 66-book canon as the true Word of God?

👉 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?
✔️ God’s preserved, unchanged Word?
❌ Or a version of the Bible altered by religious institutions?
🚨 CHOOSE WISELY—YOUR ETERNAL DESTINY DEPENDS ON IT!

🙏 POWERFUL PRAYER TO STAND ON GOD’S TRUE WORD
"Lord Jesus, I believe Your Word is true, unchanging, and eternal. Help me to stand firm on the truth and reject every false teaching. Fill me with wisdom and boldness to defend the real Bible against deception. In Jesus’ mighty name, AMEN!"
